root.label: Arizona SNAP caseload collapse after federal changes

events.label: Arizona SNAP caseload collapse after federal changes

slots.name: people lost aid
slots.sentence: Arizona is the place in the country that’s had the largest reduction in food stamps since the passage of the Big, Beautiful Bill. The rolls there have fallen in half. 450,000 people have lost nutrition aid there.

slots.name: benefit penalty
slots.sentence: So in order to avoid a $300 million penalty and potentially losing the program altogether, Arizona officials made dramatic changes to the program.

slots.name: caseworker reduction
slots.sentence: So it lost 1/3 of its caseworkers at the very time it was asking people to submit more paperwork.

slots.name: national SNAP decline
slots.sentence: Nationally, the rolls are down about 4 and 1/2 million people, or maybe 10 percent percent of the people getting SNAP have left the rolls.

slots.name: monthly SNAP aid
slots.sentence: She was receiving about $700 a month in SNAP aid. That’s about 1/3 of her income.

slots.name: appeals wait
slots.sentence: She never heard anything back. It’s been five months. She’s still waiting.

slots.name: annual SNAP cost
slots.sentence: It had more than doubled in size since 2000. About 1 in 8 Americans get snap. And its annual cost had exceeded $100 billion.

slots.name: interview deadline
slots.sentence: Once you apply for SNAP benefits, you have to have an interview with a special caseworker. And it has to happen within two weeks of the application.

slots.name: calls made
slots.sentence: She makes 100 calls in a single month, still can’t get through.

events.label: Millions lose food aid amid new SNAP requirements
